name: Refresh data by timestamp
description:
Refreshes the dataset.

This endpoint can be used if you only need to access the most recent data from a certain point in time. For example, if you only want to retrieve The
most recent data from the last time you accessed the system, you would pass the query parameter ?updated_at=1676173763. (unix timestamp)
whenToUse: Call to fetch only records changed since a given updated_at unix timestamp for incremental sync rather than re-pulling all data (mutating).

queryParameters.name: updated_at
queryParameters.description: The unix timestamp from which the refreshed data should be sent from, if no value is passed the system will assume you require all data.

queryParameters.name: include
queryParameters.description: Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes

queryParameters.name: include_static
queryParameters.description:
This include will return the full set of static variables used in the application including:
  - Currencies
  - Countries
  - Languages
  - Payment Types
  - Email Templatees
  - Industries

queryParameters.name: clear_cache
queryParameters.description:
Clears cache

Clears (and rebuilds) the static variable cache.
